source_title: 양형들이랑 영주의전당 다녀왔는데 싸움구경 하고 옴 ㅋㅋㅋ
subtitle: 신규 인던 영주의 전당 — 드루·전사 싸우는 사이 조용히 싹쓸이한 진짜 흑막

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
신규 인던 영주의 전당…
전사님 입던하자마자
낙사로 누움?!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot looking down at the stone dungeon entrance of the Lord's Hall on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. On the lower-left, the Orc Warrior girl (top-row #1 on Draft C cast sheet) has faceplanted flat on the cobblestones after failing an entrance jump, an axe knocked aside, tiny dust puff rising with a cute translucent cartoon ghost soul floating upward from her limp body with dizzy spiral eyes. On the lower-right, the Skyborne Mage girl (bottom-row #4) stands leaning forward in disbelief with a dramatic jaw-drop and floating blue sweat drops. In the far background, silhouette extras of party members watch in silence. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale in lower two-thirds, top 35% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
주문력 18 붙은 단검을
탱딜이 왜 굴려?!
무조건 캐스터 딜템이지!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. In the right foreground, the bulky armored back and foreground shoulder of the Orc Warrior frame the cut. In the left background, the Tauren Druid girl (bottom-row #8 on Draft C cast sheet) angrily slams her open hand against a rustic wooden dungeon chest edge, pointing fiercely at a gleaming fantasy ceremonial dagger (Magmatus's Fang) lying on the chest, puffing out sulky red cheeks with cartoon steam jetting from her horns! Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, leaving upper-right 46% clear white space for speech bubbles. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
골렘수호 사슬 갑옷도
나왔잖아 다 뉴비인데
누가 누굴 가르쳐!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the Orc Warrior girl (top-row #1 on Draft C cast sheet) on the lower-left, wielding a 1H war axe and a sturdy spiked metal shield, leaning aggressively forward in a fierce shouting stance with jagged shark-teeth yell, vein popping on forehead with dynamic comic speed lines! Beside her, a dropped ring-mesh mail chestguard gleams on the floor. On the lower-right, the Tauren Druid flinches with round spiral eyes. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 35% clear headroom. Zero text, zero digits.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
…싸우든 말든,
법사님 물 한 병만
더 주실래요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile 90-degree action shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. On the left, the Undead Paladin girl (bottom-row #3 on Draft C cast sheet) is tiptoeing sneaking sideways while holding an empty fantasy corked glass flask in both hands (1H mace sheathed on belt), totally deadpan emotionless face with dark comic shadow over her hollow eyes, tapping the shoulder of the Skyborne Mage girl on the right. The mage turns around with a baffled side-eye expression. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, generous pure white upper space for dialogue. Zero text, zero digits.

Dynamic Dutch tilt diagonal angle frame with tilted camera on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. Centered dramatic comedic freeze-frame of ONLY the Skyborne Mage girl (bottom-row #4 on Draft C cast sheet). She is frozen in utter blank white-eyed petrified disbelief, jaw dropped wide open in an exaggerated comic gasp, a tiny ghost soul floating out of her mouth, two large blue teardrop sweat bubbles hovering beside her head. Zero text, zero digits.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
싸우는 틈에 초록 판금템
혼자 싹쓸이하고 귀환?!
네가 진짜 흑막이었냐!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. In the lower-left, the Undead Paladin girl is seen from behind stepping into a glowing cyan Hearthstone magical vortex, a sack stuffed with green plate armor heaved over her back, casually waving goodbye over her shoulder with an unrepentant smirk. On the lower-right, the Skyborne Mage girl screams in comical fury with waterfall anime tears shooting from both eyes, waving her wooden staff wildly! Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 34% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.
